checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for secp256r1 Public Key Coordinate Bounds Validation

reachability.notes: Attacker controls qx and qy values in calldata.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Craft a transaction calling the secp256r1 precompile (address 0x100) with public key coordinates qx=p (field modulus), qy=p, qx=2^256-1, qy=2^256-1, and qx=p-1, qy=p-1. 2. Execute the transaction across multiple client implementations. 3. Verify all clients return empty output (0 bytes) for qx >= p or qy >= p. 4. Verify qx=p-1 and qy=p-1 are accepted (if on curve). 5. Check that no client panics, returns different-length output, or produces different success/failure results.
executable_checks: Deploy test contract that calls precompile with boundary coordinates
Compare return values across geth, nethermind, besu, erigon, reth
Fuzz qx and qy in range [p-10, p+10] and [2^256-10, 2^256-1]
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7951-PRECOND-003. Boundary edge EDGE-TX-TO-PRECOMPILE. Trust level: UNTRUSTED. Covers nodes: ACTION-CHECK-PUBKEY-BOUNDS, STATE-PUBKEY-BOUNDS-VALID, STATE-PUBKEY-BOUNDS-INVALID. Different big-integer libraries may handle values >= p differently, causing consensus splits.

checklist.title: Falsify secp256r1 Signature Malleability Invariant

reachability.notes: ECDSA signatures on secp256r1 have inherent malleability (s vs n-s). If not properly canonicalized, different clients may accept/reject differently.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Generate a valid secp256r1 signature (r, s) for a known message and public key. 2. Compute the malleable counterpart (r, n-s). 3. Submit both signatures to the precompile via on-chain transactions. 4. Verify all clients produce identical results for both: either both return success (0x01) or both return empty. 5. If any client differs on the malleable signature, consensus split is possible. 6. Test with s values at the boundary: s = n/2, s = n/2+1.
executable_checks: Generate valid signature and its malleable form (r, n-s)
Execute both through precompile on all EL clients
Verify identical return values across all implementations
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7951-INV-004. Internal property, Formal Verification mindset. EIP-7951 does NOT mandate high-s rejection (unlike secp256k1 in Ethereum TX signatures). Both s and n-s must produce identical verification results across all clients.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for Column Sidecar KZG Proof Verification in Fork Choice

reachability.notes: Attacker can send column sidecars with invalid KZG proofs via P2P gossip.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Craft a DataColumnSidecar with valid structural format but invalid KZG cell proofs. 2. Send the sidecar via P2P gossip to target nodes. 3. Verify the node rejects the sidecar and penalizes the sending peer. 4. Test with proofs that are valid points on BLS12-381 but don't correspond to the commitment. 5. Test with the identity element as a proof. 6. Verify that the fork choice rule does not consider blocks with unverified column data as having satisfied data availability.
executable_checks: Craft DataColumnSidecar with forged KZG proofs
Send via gossip and verify rejection
Test that fork choice excludes blocks lacking verified DA
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-FULUFC-PRECOND-007. Boundary edge EDGE-P2P-SIDECARS-TO-DA. Trust level: UNTRUSTED. Covers KZG proof verification at the fork choice DA boundary. Bypassing this allows fake data availability.

checklist.title: Falsify Proposer Boost and Timeliness Recording Post-condition

reachability.notes: Proposer boost timing affects fork choice weight.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit a block at the exact SECONDS_PER_SLOT/INTERVALS_PER_SLOT boundary. 2. Verify proposer boost is correctly applied or not based on timeliness. 3. Check that is_timely flag on the store is set correctly. 4. Verify that late blocks do not receive proposer boost. 5. Test at the fork activation boundary to ensure Fulu-specific timeliness rules are applied.
executable_checks: Simulate block arrival at timeliness boundary
Verify proposer boost weight calculation
Test across fork activation epoch boundary
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-FULUFC-POSTCOND-003. Internal property, Formal Verification mindset. Post-condition on proposer boost application and timeliness recording in fork choice.

checklist.title: Falsify Proposer Lookahead Initialization at Fork Activation

reachability.notes: Incorrect lookahead initialization at fork boundary causes proposer disagreements.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Simulate the Fulu fork activation at the exact epoch boundary. 2. Verify that proposer_lookahead is initialized with exactly (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1) * SLOTS_PER_EPOCH entries. 3. Verify each entry is a valid validator index from the active validator set. 4. Compare the initialized lookahead across multiple CL client implementations. 5. Test with edge cases: validator set changes at the fork epoch, very small validator sets, maximum validator sets.
executable_checks: Simulate fork activation and dump proposer_lookahead
Cross-client comparison of initialized lookahead values
Test with validator set mutations at fork epoch
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7917-POSTCOND-003. Internal property, Formal Verification mindset. EIP-7917 deterministic proposer lookahead must be correctly initialized at Fulu fork activation.

checklist.title: Falsify CLZ Opcode Post-condition for Non-Zero Inputs

reachability.notes: Attacker can invoke CLZ opcode with arbitrary 256-bit inputs via smart contract.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Deploy a contract that calls the CLZ opcode with various non-zero inputs. 2. Test boundary values: 1, 2^255, 2^256-1, 2^128, 2^128-1. 3. Test single-bit inputs at each of the 256 bit positions. 4. Verify CLZ returns 256-1-floor(log2(x)) for each non-zero x. 5. Compare results across all EL client implementations. 6. Verify gas consumption is exactly as specified.
executable_checks: Deploy CLZ test contract with comprehensive input coverage
Cross-client comparison of CLZ results for all 256 bit positions
Verify CLZ(0) returns 256 across all clients
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7939-POSTCOND-002. Internal property (Post-condition), Formal Verification mindset. EIP-7939 CLZ opcode must be deterministic across all clients.

checklist.title: Falsify Effective Balance Manipulation Prevention in Proposer Selection

reachability.notes: Attacker may try to manipulate effective balance to influence proposer selection.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Verify that the proposer lookahead uses effective balances frozen at the epoch boundary. 2. Attempt to change a validator's effective balance within the lookahead window and verify the proposer assignment doesn't change. 3. Verify that the seed used for proposer selection is deterministic and based on RANDAO at the correct epoch. 4. Test that the lookahead is recomputed correctly when epoch transitions occur.
executable_checks: Simulate effective balance change mid-epoch and verify no lookahead change
Verify RANDAO seed usage in proposer selection
Cross-client comparison of proposer assignments
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7917-PRECOND-004. Pre-condition property, Formal Verification mindset. EIP-7917 prevents effective balance manipulation from affecting the already-computed lookahead.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for KZG Cell Proof Verification in DataColumnSidecar

reachability.notes: Attacker sends sidecar with invalid KZG proofs to inject corrupted data or exploit proof verification bugs.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Craft a DataColumnSidecar with valid format and valid inclusion proof but invalid KZG cell proofs. 2. Send via P2P gossip to target CL nodes. 3. Verify the sidecar is rejected at the KZG verification step. 4. Test with: (a) random bytes as proofs, (b) valid BLS points that don't match commitments, (c) proofs from a different column, (d) proofs for wrong cells. 5. Verify peer scoring penalty is applied. 6. Verify the sidecar is not stored or forwarded.
executable_checks: Craft sidecar with swapped KZG proofs between columns
Send invalid sidecar and verify rejection + peer penalty
Verify no partial storage of invalid sidecar data
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-DASCORE-PRECOND-004. Boundary edge EDGE-RECEIVE-SIDECAR / EDGE-CHECK-KZG. Trust level: UNTRUSTED. This is the core DAS security guarantee - forging KZG proofs breaks data availability.

checklist.title: Verify Post-KZG-Validation State Transitions for DataColumnSidecar

reachability.notes: After KZG validation passes, sidecar must be correctly stored and made available for sampling.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Send a valid DataColumnSidecar with correct KZG proofs. 2. Verify the node transitions to STATE-SIDECAR-VALIDATED. 3. Verify the sidecar is stored in the column store. 4. Verify the sidecar is available for sampling requests. 5. Verify the sidecar can be served to other peers via Req/Resp.
executable_checks: Send valid sidecar and verify storage
Query stored sidecar via Req/Resp and verify data integrity
Verify sidecar counts toward data availability quorum
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-DASCORE-PRECOND-004. Supporting node check for boundary property. Validates correct state transition after KZG verification passes.

checklist.title: Falsify Data Availability Failure Propagation on KZG Verification Failure

reachability.notes: If a sampled column fails KZG, the entire block's DA must be marked failed.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Set up a node to sample columns for a block. 2. Provide one column with an invalid KZG proof among otherwise valid columns. 3. Verify the node marks data availability as FAILED for the entire block. 4. Verify the node does not attest to the block. 5. Test edge case: all columns valid except the last one sampled.
executable_checks: Provide partially invalid column set and verify DA failure
Verify no attestation is produced for blocks with DA failure
Test with invalid column at various positions in sampling order
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-DASCORE-POSTCOND-004. Internal property (Post-condition), Formal Verification mindset. A single KZG failure must invalidate the entire block's DA status.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for Req/Resp Column Validation Parity with Gossip

reachability.notes: Columns received via Req/Resp must undergo identical validation as gossip-received columns.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Send an invalid DataColumnSidecar via gossip and verify it is rejected. 2. Send the same invalid sidecar via Req/Resp DataColumnSidecarsByRoot. 3. Verify it is also rejected with the same validation result. 4. Test all validation steps: format, inclusion proof, KZG proofs. 5. Verify that any validation step skipped in the Req/Resp path but present in gossip represents a bypass vulnerability.
executable_checks: Send identical invalid sidecar via both gossip and Req/Resp
Compare validation outcomes for both paths
Enumerate validation steps in both code paths and diff
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-DASCORE-PRECOND-007. Boundary edge EDGE-REQRESP-COLUMN-REQUEST. Trust level: UNTRUSTED. Validation asymmetry between gossip and Req/Resp is a common class of bugs.

checklist.title: Falsify Block Size Limit Enforcement (MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE)

reachability.notes: Blocks exceeding MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE must be rejected entirely.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct a block whose RLP encoding exceeds MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE. 2. Propagate the block via P2P. 3. Verify all EL clients reject the block. 4. Test with block exactly at MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE (should be accepted) and MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE+1 (should be rejected). 5. Test with blocks containing many small transactions vs few large transactions to exercise different RLP encoding paths. 6. Verify that the check occurs before full block processing to prevent resource exhaustion.
executable_checks: Craft block at exactly MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE boundary
Cross-client comparison of acceptance/rejection
Verify early rejection prevents full block processing
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP7934-POSTCOND-001. Internal property (Post-condition), Formal Verification mindset. EIP-7934 introduces RLP block size limits for Fusaka.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for GetCells Request Format Validation

reachability.notes: Malformed GetCells requests from untrusted peers must be rejected.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Send a GetCells (0x12) request with invalid format: empty request, oversized request, invalid SSZ encoding, invalid cell indices (>= CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB). 2. Verify the node responds with an appropriate error and does not crash. 3. Test with maximum-size valid requests. 4. Test with duplicate cell indices in the request. 5. Verify rate limiting is enforced.
executable_checks: Send malformed GetCells requests via P2P
Verify error responses without node crash
Test cell index bounds validation
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP8070-PRECOND-002. Boundary property, Boundary Guard mindset. EIP-8070 GetCells is a new P2P message type requiring rigorous format validation.

checklist.title: Falsify Peer Misbehavior Flagging for Missing Noise Columns

reachability.notes: Peers failing to return noise columns should be flagged for misbehavior.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Request noise columns from a peer that should have them (based on custody assignment). 2. Have the peer return an empty response or omit the noise columns. 3. Verify the requesting node flags the peer for misbehavior. 4. Verify the peer score is decremented appropriately. 5. Test threshold: after how many failures is the peer disconnected?
executable_checks: Simulate peer withholding noise columns
Verify peer scoring penalty applied
Test disconnection threshold
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP8070-POSTCOND-002. Internal property (Post-condition), Formal Verification mindset. EIP-8070 noise column enforcement in peer scoring.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for eth/69 ForkID Validation During Handshake

reachability.notes: Malicious peer can send crafted ForkID in eth/69 Status message.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Connect to a node using eth/69 and send a Status message with an invalid ForkID (wrong hash or wrong next fork). 2. Verify the node disconnects the peer. 3. Test with ForkID from a pre-Fusaka chain. 4. Test with ForkID that has correct hash but wrong next value. 5. Test with ForkID from a different network (different genesis). 6. Verify that the dropped pre-merge fields (totalDifficulty) don't cause parsing errors.
executable_checks: Send eth/69 Status with invalid ForkID variants
Verify disconnection for incompatible ForkIDs
Test eth/69 without totalDifficulty field
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W2-EIP7642-HANDSHAKE-PRECOND-03. Boundary edge EDGE-P2P-ETH69-HANDSHAKE. Trust level: UNTRUSTED. EIP-7642 drops pre-merge fields from eth/69; ForkID validation must still work correctly.

checklist.title: Falsify Block Serving Within Advertised Range After BlockRangeUpdate

reachability.notes: Node must serve blocks within the range it advertised via BlockRangeUpdate.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Observe a node's BlockRangeUpdate message to determine its advertised range [earliestBlock, latestBlock]. 2. Request blocks within this range and verify they are served correctly. 3. Request blocks outside this range and verify appropriate error response. 4. Test at range boundaries: earliestBlock-1 and latestBlock+1. 5. Verify range updates correctly after new blocks are received.
executable_checks: Query blocks at advertised range boundaries
Verify correct error for out-of-range requests
Monitor BlockRangeUpdate consistency
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W2-EIP7642-HISTORY-POSTCOND-01. Internal property (Post-condition), Formal Verification mindset. EIP-7642 BlockRangeUpdate protocol correctness.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for DataColumnSidecar Slot Timeliness Check

reachability.notes: Attacker can send sidecars with future or stale slots.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Send a DataColumnSidecar with a slot far in the future (current_slot + 100). 2. Verify it is rejected (IGNORE). 3. Send a sidecar with slot = current_slot + 1 (within MAXIMUM_GOSSIP_CLOCK_DISPARITY). 4. Verify handling is correct. 5. Send a sidecar with slot below finalization. 6. Verify it is rejected. 7. Test at exact MAXIMUM_GOSSIP_CLOCK_DISPARITY boundary.
executable_checks: Send sidecar with future slot beyond clock disparity
Send sidecar at exact disparity boundary
Send sidecar below finalized slot
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W2-FULU-GOSSIP-PRECOND-03. Boundary property, Boundary Guard mindset. Step 3 of the 13-step gossip validation pipeline.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for DataColumnSidecar Proposer Index Verification

reachability.notes: Attacker can send sidecars with incorrect proposer index.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Craft a DataColumnSidecar with a valid signature but incorrect proposer index (a validator who is not the expected proposer for that slot). 2. Send via gossip and verify rejection. 3. Test with the proposer from an adjacent slot. 4. Verify that the proposer index is checked against the deterministic lookahead (EIP-7917). 5. Test at epoch boundaries where the proposer set changes.
executable_checks: Send sidecar with wrong proposer index
Verify rejection and peer penalty
Test proposer validation at epoch boundary
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W2-FULU-GOSSIP-PRECOND-11. Boundary property, Boundary Guard mindset. Step 13 of the gossip validation pipeline. Must use EIP-7917 deterministic lookahead.

checklist.title: Falsify Invariant: Served Sidecars Must Be Within Advertised Range and Valid

reachability.notes: Node must only serve sidecars within data_column_serve_range and that have passed gossip validation.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Request DataColumnSidecars via DataColumnSidecarsByRange for a range within data_column_serve_range. 2. Verify all returned sidecars are valid (pass full validation). 3. Request sidecars outside the serve range and verify ResourceUnavailable error (code 3). 4. Verify response ordering: ascending by (slot, column_index). 5. Verify response count does not exceed MAX_REQUEST_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS.
executable_checks: Request sidecars within and outside serve range
Validate all served sidecars pass full verification
Verify response ordering and count limits
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W2-FULU-REQRESP-INV-01. Internal property (Invariant), Formal Verification mindset. Ensures Req/Resp serving correctness.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for Custody Requirement Check During Peer Discovery

reachability.notes: Malicious peer can advertise false custody_group_count in ENR.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Advertise an ENR with custody_group_count (cgc) < CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT. 2. Verify the connecting node rejects or deprioritizes the peer. 3. Advertise cgc = 0 and verify handling. 4. Advertise cgc = NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS (supernode) and verify acceptance. 5. Test that peers with insufficient custody are not relied upon for DA sampling.
executable_checks: Connect with ENR advertising cgc < CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT
Verify peer rejection or deprioritization
Test cgc=0 edge case
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W2-FULU-DISCOVERY-PRECOND-02. Boundary edge EDGE-DISCOVERY-ENR-CUSTODY. Trust level: UNTRUSTED. False custody claims can degrade data availability.

checklist.title: Falsify BlobSidecar Protocol Deprecation After Fulu Transition

reachability.notes: BlobSidecar topics/protocols should be deprecated after Fulu activation.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. After Fulu activation, attempt to gossip a BlobSidecar on the old topic. 2. Verify the node ignores or rejects it. 3. Attempt to request BlobSidecars via the old Req/Resp protocol. 4. Verify appropriate error or empty response. 5. Verify no code path still processes BlobSidecars post-fork.
executable_checks: Send BlobSidecar on old gossip topic post-Fulu
Request BlobSidecars via old Req/Resp post-Fulu
Verify clean protocol deprecation
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W2-FULU-FORK-POSTCOND-01. Internal property (Post-condition), Formal Verification mindset. Fulu replaces BlobSidecars with DataColumnSidecars.

checklist.title: Falsify Proposer Lookahead Initialization After Fulu Fork Upgrade

reachability.notes: Non-deterministic or incorrect initialization at fork causes proposer disagreements.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute the Fulu fork upgrade on a test state. 2. Verify proposer_lookahead is initialized with correct length and entries. 3. Execute the same upgrade on multiple CL clients and compare results byte-for-byte. 4. Test with different pre-fork states (varying validator set sizes, balances). 5. Verify the initialization uses the correct epoch for seed computation.
executable_checks: Execute fork upgrade on identical pre-state across clients
Compare proposer_lookahead values byte-for-byte
Test with minimum and maximum validator sets
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W3-FULU-FORK-TRANSITION-POST-002. Internal property (Post-condition), Formal Verification mindset. CRITICAL: incorrect fork transition could split the entire network.

checklist.title: Falsify Post-condition: get_beacon_proposer_index Uses Pre-computed Lookahead

reachability.notes: get_beacon_proposer_index must use the pre-computed proposer_lookahead, not recompute.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Initialize a Fulu state with proposer_lookahead populated. 2. Call get_beacon_proposer_index and verify it returns the value from proposer_lookahead[slot % len(proposer_lookahead)]. 3. Modify the state (change balances, activate/exit validators) and verify the returned proposer doesn't change within the same lookahead window. 4. Verify the function does NOT fall back to compute_proposer_index.
executable_checks: Call get_beacon_proposer_index and compare with lookahead array
Modify state and verify no lookahead change within window
Verify no fallback to compute_proposer_index
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W3-FULU-BEACON-LOOKAHEAD-POST-001. Internal property (Post-condition), Formal Verification mindset. EIP-7917 requires using pre-computed values.

checklist.title: Falsify Fork Digest XOR Computation Correctness

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Compute the Fulu fork digest using FULU_FORK_VERSION and the genesis_validators_root for mainnet. 2. Compare across all CL client implementations. 3. Verify the digest is computed as compute_fork_digest(FULU_FORK_VERSION, genesis_validators_root). 4. Verify the SSZ hash_tree_root of ForkData is computed correctly. 5. Test with different genesis_validators_root values to ensure no hardcoding.

Compare results byte-for-byte
Verify no hardcoded digest values

Verify the lookahead is initialized as part of the state transition, not lazily. 4. Test concurrent access patterns: block processing and proposer queries happening simultaneously. 5. Verify no default/zero values are returned for uninitialized lookahead.

Verify initialization ordering in state transition
Test for race conditions in concurrent access
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W3-FULU-BEACON-LOOKAHEAD-INV-002. Internal property (Invariant), Formal Verification mindset. CRITICAL: uninitialized lookahead at fork activation is a consensus split vector.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for P2P Block Validation with Recalculated Excess Blob Gas

reachability.notes: P2P received blocks must have excess_blob_gas recalculated and verified.

Test at the fork boundary where the blob base fee formula changes (EIP-7918). 4. Verify the node uses the correct formula (parent's excess + parent's used - target) for the block's fork epoch. 5. Test transition blocks: last pre-Fusaka block and first Fusaka block.

Verify rejection at the EIP-7918 transition boundary
Test formula change at exact fork slot

checklist.title: Falsify Fork Digest Verification for Peer Connections

reachability.notes: Peers with wrong fork digest should be disconnected after grace period.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Connect with a peer advertising the pre-Fulu fork digest in ENR after Fulu activation. 2. Verify disconnection occurs after the grace period. 3. Test gossip messages on topics with wrong fork digest prefix. 4. Verify they are rejected. 5. Test during the fork transition: verify peers with next_fork_digest (nfd) set correctly are not prematurely disconnected.

Verify disconnection after grace period
Test gossip topic fork digest filtering
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W3-FULU-FORK-DIGEST-POST-002. Internal property (Post-condition), Formal Verification mindset. Fork digest enforcement prevents cross-fork communication.

Test a block at timestamp = FUSAKA_TIMESTAMP - 1 (should use old formula). 3. Test a block at timestamp = FUSAKA_TIMESTAMP (should use new formula). 4. Cross-client comparison of the transition block. 5. Verify the activation is timestamp-based (not slot-based) on EL side.

Verify correct formula used for each
Cross-client comparison of transition block state root

Verify other peers can discover this node correctly based on the updated ENR. 4. Test with multiple sequential BPO forks.

checklist.title: Falsify ModExp Multiplication Complexity at 32-Byte Boundary

reachability.notes: Attacker controls base_length and modulus_length. Boundary at 32 bytes is critical.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Call ModExp precompile with max(base_length, modulus_length) = 32. Verify complexity = 16. 2. Call with max = 33. Verify complexity = 2 * ceil(33/8)^2 = 2 * 5^2 = 50. 3. Call with max = 31. Verify complexity = 16 (minimum). 4. Test with max = 0, 1, 8, 16, 32, 33, 64, 128, 1024. 5. Cross-client comparison of gas consumed for each case. 6. Verify the new EIP-7883 formula is used post-Fusaka (not the old formula).

Cross-client gas consumption comparison
Verify EIP-7883 formula activation at Fusaka
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W4-EIP7883-POSTCOND-001. Internal property (Post-condition), Formal Verification mindset. EIP-7883 changes ModExp gas cost. The 32-byte boundary is a discontinuity point.

checklist.title: Falsify ModExp Zero-Padding Behavior for Short Calldata

reachability.notes: Short calldata with large declared lengths: different zero-padding implementations could diverge.

Verify all clients zero-pad the missing bytes identically. 3. Test with declared lengths >> actual calldata (e.g., declared 1024 bytes each, only 96 bytes provided). 4. Test with zero-length calldata. 5. Cross-client comparison of the ModExp result.

checklist.title: Falsify Post-condition: No Attestation When Data Unavailable

Test with partial availability: some columns valid, some missing, below threshold. 4. Verify the node retries sampling before giving up. 5. After DA failure, verify the node does not change its mind if columns arrive late.

reachability.notes: Attacker can submit commitments that don't match versioned hashes.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Craft a blob transaction with valid-looking KZG commitments that don't hash to the versioned_hashes in the transaction. 2. Submit via P2P or transaction pool. 3. Verify the transaction is rejected. 4. Test with: (a) correct commitment, wrong hash, (b) wrong commitment, correct hash, (c) hash with wrong version byte. 5. Verify the hash function: SHA256(commitment)[1:] with version prefix.

checklist.title: Falsify Post-condition: All Cell Proofs Verified Before Mempool Admission

reachability.notes: Mempool admission must guarantee all proofs verified.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Trace the blob transaction validation pipeline in the codebase. 2. Verify cell proof batch verification occurs BEFORE mempool insertion. 3. Test with a blob transaction where one cell proof is invalid among otherwise valid proofs. 4. Verify the entire transaction is rejected (not partially accepted). 5. Verify the rejection prevents P2P propagation of the invalid transaction.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for Block Rejection on Transaction Gas Limit Violation

reachability.notes: Blocks with transactions exceeding 16,777,216 gas limit must be rejected entirely.

Test boundary: gasLimit = 16,777,216 (should be accepted), 16,777,217 (should be rejected). 5. Verify the block is rejected BEFORE state transition to prevent partial processing. 6. Cross-client comparison.

Verify no partial state transition on rejection

checklist.title: Falsify Proposer Lookahead Length and Validity After Fork State Transition

reachability.notes: Non-deterministic or incorrect lookahead computation causes proposer disagreements.

Verify each entry is a valid validator index from the active validator set. 4. Verify no duplicate entries where the same validator appears in impossible positions. 5. Cross-client comparison of the full lookahead array.

Verify all entries are valid active validator indices
Cross-client byte-for-byte comparison

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for FULU_FORK_VERSION in Signature Domain

reachability.notes: Malicious validator could send blocks/attestations with wrong fork version.

Verify the node rejects the block due to signature verification failure. 3. Send an attestation with pre-Fulu domain. 4. Verify rejection. 5. Test the exact epoch boundary: last Electra slot and first Fulu slot. 6. Verify voluntary exits and other signed messages also use correct domain.

checklist.title: Falsify PRIMITIVE_ROOT_OF_UNITY Validity as Subgroup Generator

reachability.notes: If PRIMITIVE_ROOT_OF_UNITY is wrong, all FFT operations are incorrect.

checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Verify PRIMITIVE_ROOT_OF_UNITY^(2^k) == 1 where 2^k is the required subgroup order. 2. Verify PRIMITIVE_ROOT_OF_UNITY^(2^(k-1)) != 1 (it's a generator, not a lower-order element). 3. Verify the constant is within the BLS12-381 scalar field (< BLS_MODULUS). 4. Cross-implementation comparison of the constant value. 5. Compute a simple FFT and verify correctness against a known test vector.

Verify it's a generator (not lower-order element)
Cross-implementation comparison of the constant
